timer.purpose: The vial's centered countdown number — the largest text in the app.

body.purpose: Functional copy: buttons, inputs, chat messages, goal text.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows: phase label, section tags, quote-card tag.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for the goals card and regimen-progress card.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The open Dosey chat panel, the app's one floating surface.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions and Framer Motion animations app-wide.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action per view (e.g. 'Begin dose').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2E2433; color: #F6F2EC; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9B7FC4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6B5E6F; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #DED5C8; font-family: 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #2E2433; border-color: #6B5E6F; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9B7FC4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Lilac accent action: add-goal, chat send.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #C9B6E4; color: #2E2433; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-family: 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #9B7FC4; color: #F6F2EC; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9B7FC4; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Goal composer / chat composer text field.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #EFE9DF; border: 1px solid #DED5C8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #2E2433; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B5E6F; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #9B7FC4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(201,182,228,0.3); }

components.name: Card Surface
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F6F2EC; border: 1px solid #DED5C8; border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 white inset, 0 8px 26px -18px rgba(46,36,51,.10); }

components.name: Phase Tab
components.description: Session-type selector (Focus / Short break / Long break).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; background: #EFE9DF; border: 1px solid #DED5C8; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #6B5E6F; font-family: 'Spline Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #2E2433; } .ds-tab-active { background: #F6F2EC; color: #2E2433; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(46,36,51,0.08); }

narrative.overview: Pomodose is built as a personal gift — a Pomodoro timer, daily goal list, and AI companion themed around a pharmacist's daily dosing ritual. The system reads like a well-kept apothecary counter: warm paper, glass and lilac tincture, careful measurement marks, a steady hand. Every session is called a 'dose'; the signature timer is drawn as a filling/draining glass vial, never a generic circular progress ring. Copy speaks directly and gently to 'Doc' rather than at 'the user'. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS login/dashboard template — no cold corporate auth forms, no centered-card-on-gradient boilerplate, no gamified streak badges or confetti, nothing clinical or hospital-sterile. It is one calm page, not a multi-panel dashboard, and any new surface (including an access gate) should feel like it was drawn by the same hand as the vial timer and the goal list, not bolted on from a component library.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, editorial, apothecary-calm — gentle precision over corporate efficiency.
One consistent voice: short, sincere, addressed to 'Doc.'
A restrained, muted palette; no saturated 'productivity app' colors.
Fraunces serif for moments of personality; Spline Sans for everything functional.
Soft, low-contrast elevation — shadows are a whisper, not a drop shadow.

rules.name: The One Border Rule
rules.body: Every border in the app is border-line (#DED5C8) at 1px. No exceptions, no secondary border colors.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Lilac is the only saturated-ish color in the palette and appears on a minority of any given screen.

rules.name: The Fraunces-for-Feeling Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only where the app is being personal or precise — never in dense functional UI. Spline Sans carries function; Fraunces carries feeling.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses rgba(46,36,51,...) at low opacity, never black, paired with a 0 1px 0 white inset highlight.

dos: Do use border-line (#DED5C8) as the only border color, everywhere, at 1px.
Do keep Fraunces for feeling and Spline Sans for function.
Do use the ink-tinted whisper shadow + white inset highlight for any new elevated surface.
Do speak to the user as 'Doc' in short, warm, specific lines.
Do keep any new surface on this one calm page's visual register.
donts: Don't use a circular SVG ring, bar, or generic progress component for anything timer-related.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or any system-default sans as a primary typeface.
Don't build a generic SaaS login screen.
Don't introduce a second border color, a second shadow color, or a saturated accent beyond lilac/sage/clay.
Don't build a sidebar-nav-plus-stat-cards dashboard layout.
